decision.applicability_reason: Project metadata records a delay/time-extension scenario.
decision.explanation: The governing document (General_Conditions.pdf) states that 'any delay automatically extends contract time for the length of the delay without further demonstration or timely supporting notice.' The time-extension clause in General_Conditions.pdf must be revised to reinstate the three mandatory elements under DelDOT 108.7: (1) the delay must be excusable, (2) the contractor must submit a timely written request/notice, and (3) the delay must affect the critical path or substantial-completion time. The current automatic-extension language should be deleted or replaced.
